with open("region.fasta") as f:

# longest stop-free stretch per frame (coding potential)
stop=set(['TAA','TAG','TGA'])
print("=== Longest stop-free stretch per frame ===")
for strand,s in [('+',seq),('-',''.join({'A':'T','T':'A','G':'C','C':'G'}[x] for x in reversed(seq)))]:
    for f in range(3):
        best=(0,0,0)
        i=f; run_start=f
        while i+3<=n:
            if s[i:i+3] in stop:
                if i-run_start > best[0]:
                    best=(i-run_start, run_start, i)
                run_start=i+3
            i+=3
        if n-run_start>best[0]:
            best=(n-run_start,run_start,n)
        print(f"{strand} frame{f}: len {best[0]} bp ({best[0]//3} codons) at {best[1]+1}-{best[2]}")

# GC skew cumulative
print("\n=== GC skew (cumulative) sampled ===")
skew=[]

for ch in seq:
    if ch=='G': g+=1
    elif ch=='C': c+=1
    skew.append(g-c)
for i in range(0,n,250):
    print(f"  pos {i+1}: cum GC skew {skew[i]}")
